meta.about: The levels and the game styles (modes) the front end offers (docs/unreal/LOADOUT.md 3.5). A level names its map and data files and declares what it provides; a mode declares what it needs. The Level screen lists every level; the Game style screen lists only the modes whose needs the chosen level provides. Adding a level is one entry here plus its map and its level data file.

thumbnail.notes: a 16:9 frame from the title fly-through (key 3, the avenue under the El), for a level that is not loaded

block.notes: `provides` is checked against level.json at load (MurderInc.Loadout.DataLoads): 3 objectives, an extraction zone, 29 ground and 17 air spawn points, a nav grid, cover points, 21 explosives, 14 title-camera keys. showroom null: the front end uses frontend.json stage (a point inside the level may be set later, see LOADOUT.md 2.11).

mission.notes: Story: every objective of the level is a master reel (the block has three); the truck at the extraction zone ends the run. Rules: spec 04 3.6 to 3.10, unchanged.

holdout.notes: Hold the Block: endless waves of Goons and Buzzards (both kinds, so both spawn kinds are needed); objectives, if any, stand closed; explosives, if any, come back every second wave. Rules: spec 04 3.11, unchanged; the resupply is per carried gun (LOADOUT.md 4.4).
